title: Approval of the First Amendment to Contract DA-5852 with Meyers Nave: To add $30,000 in funding, for new total not to exceed $330,000, covering provision of legal advice and representation of Los Ange
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 18]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the First Amendment to Contract DA-5852 with Meyers Nave: To add $30,000 in funding, for new total not to exceed $330,000, covering provision of legal advice and representation of Los Angeles World Airports in connection with real property matters, including litigation and concession (Brian Ostler)
summary: Approval of the First Amendment to Contract DA-5852 with Meyers Nave: To add $30,000 in funding, for new total not to exceed $330,000.
